notes:
Prospect builds IDE-integrated tooling for large engineering orgs (microservices + monorepo support). Primary ask: repository-aware retrieval for context windows in copilot UX (prefetch embeddings per repo, per-branch namespaces). Wants embeddings & vector DB to remain in EU and under VPC/on-prem control. POC ask: 2-week PoC to validate latency + recall on 3 repositories (mono + service + infra).

- Latency targets: interactive completions streaming with token latency ~<60ms typical, p95 <200ms; overall response times under 500ms for short completions.
- Throughput: hundreds of concurrent VS Code sessions during peak.
- Embeddings: prefer open-source embedding model (small, quantizable) or Redwood-verified embedding that can run in private. Store vectors in self-hosted Milvus/FAISS; namespace per repo/branch.
- Chunking strategy: 512 token rolling windows for code, 1024 for long docs; aggressive de-dup + fingerprinting to reduce vector bloat.
- Model/version pinning: need ability to pin stable 7B-quantized for completions but fallback to larger models for complex refactors. Automatic routing by cost/latency is interesting but must be controllable.
- Security: SSO/SAML required, SOC2 mandatory, KMS/HSM integration for key control, audit logs for query/ingest, retention controls for embeddings. Quote from CTO: "We cannot allow repo code copies to leave EU or third-party managed indices without contract-level guarantees."

Current stance: leaning towards Redwood Private if on-prem connectors are robust; Dedicated considered if we can guarantee data residency + per-tenant vector storage. Open to Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/caching to reduce token cost.

Stated timeline: legal + security sign-off in March; budget review early April. AE/Jordan: push POC SOW by 2026-03-12 (delayed), coordinate SRE sync for infra runbook.
